context: The solution must use the specify-cli package to initialize spec-driven projects programmatically. Evaluation focuses entirely on correct invocation of the CLI and validation of its output. Internal implementation details of specify-cli are not assessed.

checklist.name: CLI invocation
checklist.description: Invokes `specify` (or `python -m specify`) as a subprocess with an appropriate init-related subcommand to create a project scaffold.

checklist.name: --here flag
checklist.description: Passes the `--here` flag when initializing in the current working directory and verifies that scaffold files appear in that directory rather than a subdirectory.

checklist.name: Conflict detection
checklist.description: Detects and handles the case where the target directory already contains an existing specify project, confirming the CLI returns a non-zero exit code or prints an error message.

checklist.name: Scaffold validation
checklist.description: Checks that the expected scaffold artifacts (spec config file and specs directory) are present after a successful initialization.

checklist.name: New subdirectory creation
checklist.description: Passes a new directory name to the CLI and verifies that the directory is created and properly scaffolded.
